title: CRIU
description: Checkpoint/Restore In Userspace freezes Linux processes including TCP sockets and namespaces. Scope: Linux process tree. Checkpoint format: image files (protobuf). Restore with: criu restore -D ckpt/.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Podman checkpoint
description: Podman integrates CRIU so containers checkpoint to disk and restore on any host. Scope: OCI container. Checkpoint format: tarball of CRIU images. Restore with: podman container restore <name>.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Docker checkpoint (experimental)
description: Docker’s experimental checkpoint uses CRIU under the hood for container migration. Scope: container. Checkpoint format: CRIU image dir. Restore with: docker start --checkpoint <id>.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: QEMU live migration
description: QEMU pre-copies RAM while the VM runs, then pauses briefly for the final delta. Scope: full VM. Checkpoint format: migration stream. Restore with: qemu -incoming tcp:0:4444.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Firecracker snapshots
description: Firecracker snapshots microVM memory to files for sub-second resume of serverless functions. Scope: microVM. Checkpoint format: memory + state files. Restore with: PUT /snapshot/load.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: gVisor checkpoint
description: gVisor’s Sentry can checkpoint the entire sandbox state including goroutine stacks. Scope: sandbox. Checkpoint format: state file. Restore with: runsc checkpoint/restore.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: Erlang hot code loading
description: The BEAM swaps module code under running processes with zero downtime — checkpointing by design. Scope: BEAM VM. Checkpoint format: release packages. Restore with: release_handler:install_release/1.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: V8 startup snapshots
description: mksnapshot serializes the heap after running setup code so Node and Chrome boot faster. Scope: JS heap. Checkpoint format: snapshot blob. Restore with: linked into the binary.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: CRI-O checkpoint
description: CRI-O exposes CRIU checkpoint/restore through the Kubernetes CRI for pod migration. Scope: K8s pod sandbox. Checkpoint format: CRIU images. Restore with: crictl restore.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: LXD snapshots
description: LXD snapshots containers and VMs with optional stateful (running-memory) capture. Scope: instance. Checkpoint format: zfs/btrfs snapshot + state. Restore with: lxc restore <inst> <snap>.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: VirtualBox snapshots
description: VirtualBox differencing images let desktop VMs branch and roll back live state. Scope: desktop VM. Checkpoint format: VDI differencing chain. Restore with: VBoxManage snapshot restore.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: VMware snapshots
description: VMware’s .vmsn files capture full VM memory and device state for instant rollback. Scope: VM. Checkpoint format: .vmsn + delta disks. Restore with: revert to snapshot.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: KVM live migration
description: KVM guests migrate between hosts with dirty-page tracking keeping downtime in milliseconds. Scope: KVM guest. Checkpoint format: migration stream. Restore with: virsh migrate --live.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: DMTCP
description: Distributed MultiThreaded CheckPointing needs no root and handles MPI clusters transparently. Scope: distributed process. Checkpoint format: ckpt files per rank. Restore with: dmtcp_restart ckpt_*.dmtcp.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.

title: BLCR
description: Berkeley Lab Checkpoint/Restart was the classic HPC process checkpointer for batch systems. Scope: HPC process. Checkpoint format: context files. Restore with: cr_restart context.
provenance: Public record compiled from openly published documentation, project sources, and standard references.
